query:
SELECT 
  DATE_FORMAT(deliveryDate, '%Y-%m') AS delivery_month,
  COUNT(*) AS order_count,
  MIN(deliveryDate) AS earliest,
  MAX(deliveryDate) AS latest
FROM orders 
WHERE deliveryDate IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY delivery_month
ORDER BY delivery_month;
